visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a tight close-up of three dark, cocoa-dusted pastries shaped like bananas, glistening with chocolate sauce on a white plate. Text overlays identify the dish. The background is a wooden surface with a patterned blue cloth. (2) Hands in transparent gloves are seen cutting a circular dough sheet in half on brown parchment paper over a pink mat. The lighting is bright and studio-like. (3) The hands place chocolate bars and a half-banana onto the dough sections. Small bowls of ingredients are visible in the background. (4) The hands roll the dough around the fillings and pinch the ends to seal them. (5) The rolls are brushed with a golden egg wash using a wooden brush on a baking tray. (6) The tray is placed into a lit oven; the shot focuses on the rolls through the glass door as they begin to bake. (7) Out of the oven, golden-brown rolls are drizzled with thick chocolate sauce from above. (8) Cocoa powder is sifted over the rolls, creating a fine dark coating. (9) A hand picks up a finished roll, and a knife cuts it open to show the gooey interior of melted chocolate and banana.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat electronic music with a driving beat starts immediately. A male voice introduces the recipe with high energy and clear articulation. (2) A sharp slicing sound occurs as the dough is cut. The narrator lists the ingredient quantities over the constant BGM. (3) Plastic rustling from gloves is audible as the banana and chocolate are placed. The music maintains its energetic tempo. (4) Soft tactile sounds of dough folding and pinching are heard. (5) Repetitive soft brushing noises accompany the egg wash application. (6) A metallic click and low thud mark the oven door closing. The voice remains cheerful. (7) A viscous glugging sound is heard as the chocolate sauce is poured. The music's high-frequency synth elements become more prominent. (8) A soft rhythmic rubbing sound indicates the sifting of cocoa powder. (9) A final crisp cutting sound occurs as the roll is sliced open. The music and narration reach a positive conclusion.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Ingredient Prep -> Assembly -> Baking -> Final Coating -> Reveal
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a highly visual and rhythmic cooking guide for creating a 'Banana Dirty Bread' snack. By utilizing a popular music track and energetic narration, it demonstrates a simplified recipe using store-bought scallion pancakes to make a gourmet-looking dessert, appealing to young audiences and home bakers looking for easy, creative food trends.
